units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 2:1">Keth. II, 1</cite> <he>ח׳ קליות וכ׳</he> testifying to the distribution of roasted ears (at the wedding) is an evidence (of the bride having been a virgin).
<cite ref="Tosefta Ketubot 3:1">Tosef. ib. III, 1</cite> <he>ח׳ גרנות</he> taking a share at the distribution of priest’s gifts of the threshing floor; a. fr.

senses.gloss: division, separation, specification. Y. Sabb. VII, end, 9ᶜ bot. יצא … לח׳ it was specified, after being implicitly intimated, for division of the general law, i.e. that each of the implied acts is punishable for itself. Bab.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 70a:3">Sabb. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>ח׳ מלאכות</he> the separate treatment of each labor as a transgression of the Sabbath law.
<cite ref="Makkot 21b:10">Macc. 21ᵇ</cite>; a. fr. [<he>חלוקי כפרה</he>, v. <cite ref="H01112"><he>חָלק</he></cite>.]
